svg.title: A selection the scene resolved and the serializer drew
svg.desc: A rendered teaching Meteogram whose build received selection: { hourIndex: 3, altitudeM: 1750 }. The serializer drew the tinted selection column with its centre hairline, and a ring on the drawn wind barb the requested altitude snapped to. The scene's own computed best-hour highlight is visible on a different column.

svg.aria-label: Meteogram for Synthetic Ridge, model convective-cycle, 2000-01-01 10:00 to 19:00 (Etc/UTC): surface metric strips above a time-height field; derived series, isotherms, shading overlays and winds aloft are drawn over the profile.
